Method of Attack: Stealing user credentials by phishing through fake money adder tools that promise free in-game currency or perks
Sending stolen login credentials to attacker-controlled Gmail addresses
Attack Vector: Fake game hacking tools and money adders advertised in in-game chats, forums, and YouTube
Phishing via tools requesting user credentials under false promises
Indicators of Compromise: Gmail addresses hardcoded in the malicious tool source code receiving stolen credentials
